description: Unit test for the ImmutableJsonDouble class that verifies immutability, equality/hashcode, type identification, and conversion behaviors of ImmutableJsonDouble objects using parameterized tests.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonDoubleTest
classes.description: Test suite for ImmutableJsonDouble class, focusing on correctness, equality, and type behaviors.

classes.name: ParameterizedTests
classes.description: Contains parameterized tests that validate ImmutableJsonDouble with various double values.

methods.name: doubleValues
methods.description: Provides a collection of diverse double values, including special and boundary cases, for parameterized testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ImmutableJsonDouble instance before each test with the current parameter double value.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableJsonDouble instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies proper implementation of hashCode and equals, considering class hierarchy and potential nulls.

methods.name: jsonDoubleEqualsJsonIntIfSameValue
methods.description: Ensures equality between ImmutableJsonDouble and ImmutableJsonInt if they represent the same value.

methods.name: jsonDoubleHasSameHashCodeAsJsonIntIfSameValue
methods.description: Ensures hash codes match for ImmutableJsonDouble and ImmutableJsonInt with the same numerical value.

methods.name: jsonDoubleEqualsJsonLongIfSameValue
methods.description: Ensures equality between ImmutableJsonDouble and ImmutableJsonLong if they represent the same value.

methods.name: jsonDoubleHasSameHashCodeAsJsonLongIfSameValue
methods.description: Ensures hash codes match for ImmutableJsonDouble and ImmutableJsonLong with the same numerical value.

methods.name: getValueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getValue() returns the original double value used to create ImmutableJsonDouble.

methods.name: asDoubleReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that asDouble() returns the correct double value.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures toString() outputs the string representation of the double value.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Confirms that the value is not null.

methods.name: isNotBoolean
methods.description: Confirms that the value is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Confirms that the value is a numeric type.

methods.name: isIntReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks if isInt() correctly identifies whether the double value can be represented as an integer.

methods.name: jsonDoubleWithFractionsIsNotInt
methods.description: Verifies that a double with fractional part is not recognized as an int.

methods.name: jsonDoubleWithZeroFractionsWithinIntRangeIsEqualToSameInt
methods.description: Checks that a double value with no fractional component within int range is recognized as int.

methods.name: isLongReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks if isLong() correctly indicates whether double value fits within long range without fractions.

methods.name: jsonDoubleWithFractionsIsNotLong
methods.description: Verifies that a double with fractional part is not recognized as a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Confirms that isDouble() returns true for numeric double values.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Ensures the value is not identified as a string.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Ensures the value is not identified as an object.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Ensures the value is not identified as an array.

methods.name: tryToGetAsBoolean
methods.description: Test that calling asBoolean() throws UnsupportedOperationException for numeric value.

methods.name: getAsIntBehavesCorrectly
methods.description: Checks behavior of asInt(), expecting int or exception based on value.

methods.name: getAsLongBehavesCorrectly
methods.description: Checks behavior of asLong(), expecting long or exception based on value.

methods.name: tryToGetAsString
methods.description: Test that calling asString() throws exception for numeric value.

methods.name: tryToGetAsObject
methods.description: Test that calling asObject() throws exception for numeric value.

methods.name: tryToGetAsArray
methods.description: Test that calling asArray() throws exception for numeric value.

methods.name: isDoubleValueWithinIntegerRange
methods.description: Utility method to determine if double value fits within integer range without fractions.

methods.name: hasNoFraction
methods.description: Utility method to check if double value has no fractional part.

methods.name: isDoubleValueWithinLongRange
methods.description: Utility method to determine if double value fits within long range without fractions.
